DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.title: The Hermit
DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.description:
A lone undead gunslinger from a far away place.
Haunted by the inescapable specter of the past.
DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.cardsModifierDescrip: Hermit cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.banter: Keep your hands where I can see them.
DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.bestiaryQuote: A weathered gunslinger walking the Spire alone.
DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED_ONE.title: The Awakened
DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED_ONE.description:
The Cult's triumph and immortal dark warlock of the Beyond.
Possesses power over the Void and all other elements.
DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED_ONE.cardsModifierD: Awakened cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED_ONE.eventDeathPrev: The ritual is not yet complete.
DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED_ONE.bestiaryQuote: An ancient dark bird awakened by forbidden rites.
DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS.title: The Gremlins
DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS.description:
A chaotic mob of Spire denizens banded together
in search of food and treasure.
DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS.cardsModifierDescr: Gremlin cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS.bestiaryQuote: Five scheming gremlins swapping in and out of the fray.
